title: Municípios e Estados do Brasil (IBGE, DDD, fusos)
subtitle: 5,570 municipalities and 27 states: IBGE/SIAFI codes, DDD, IANA zones, grammar
description:
**Municípios e estados do Brasil** com códigos IBGE e SIAFI, DDD, fusos horários IANA, coordenadas e a gramática de cada estado para geração de texto. **Brazilian municipalities and states** with IBGE and SIAFI codes, phone area codes, IANA time zones, coordinates and the grammar each state name takes in Portuguese.

## Files

- `municipios.csv`: the 5,570 municipalities (5,568 + Federal District + Fernando de Noronha). IBGE code, name, ASCII name, URL slug, state, region, capital flag, latitude/longitude, DDD, SIAFI code, canonical IANA time zone, UTC offset, IBGE boundary API URL.
- `estados.csv`: the 27 federative units. IBGE code, region, capital, centre coordinates, time zone, and the article and prepositions for text generation: `no Acre`, `na Bahia`, `em Goiás`, `do Acre`, `de São Paulo`.
- Each table also comes as typed Parquet and as JSON.

## Why another municipalities table

- **Joins:** IBGE code for census and IBGE data, SIAFI code for federal transfer and Treasury data, DDD for phone data.
- **Correct time zones:** 15 canonical IANA zones instead of the 4 generic ones common in other tables, including `America/Eirunepe` for western Amazonas.
- **Text generation:** the state grammar fields let a template write "Cartórios em Goiás" and "Cartórios no Acre" without mistakes.
- **Tested:** IBGE check digits (with the 9 official exceptions), unique keys, coordinates inside Brazil and one capital per state.

Base fields credited to kelvins/municipios-brasileiros (MIT). Full data dictionary, methodology, quality report and scripts: **https://github.com/CaiqueDourado/municipios-e-estados-do-brasil**

resources.description: All 5,570 Brazilian municipalities: IBGE and SIAFI codes, state, region, capital flag, coordinates, DDD, IANA time zone and IBGE boundary URL.

fields.name: ibge_code
fields.description: IBGE municipality code (7 digits, last one is a check digit). Primary key.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Official municipality name, with accents.

fields.name: name_ascii
fields.description: Name without accents (NFKD), for search and matching.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL slug: name without accents, lowercase, hyphenated, plus the state (sao-paulo-sp). Unique.

fields.name: uf
fields.description: State abbreviation (SP, BA…).

fields.name: state_ibge_code
fields.description: IBGE state code (2 digits); equals the first two digits of ibge_code.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Region: Norte, Nordeste, Sudeste, Sul, Centro-Oeste.

fields.name: is_capital
fields.description: True for the 27 state capitals (Brasília included).

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the municipal seat, decimal degrees.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the municipal seat, decimal degrees.

fields.name: ddd
fields.description: Telephone area code.

fields.name: siafi_code
fields.description: Municipality code in SIAFI (Treasury system), 4 digits with leading zeros. Used by federal transfer data.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: Canonical IANA time zone (America/Sao_Paulo, America/Manaus, America/Eirunepe…).

fields.name: utc_offset
fields.description: Standard UTC offset (Brazil has no daylight saving time since 2019).

fields.name: mesh_url
fields.description: IBGE API v3 URL for the municipality boundary. Add ?formato=application/vnd.geo+json for GeoJSON.

fields.description: "de" + article: do, da or de (do Acre, da Bahia, de Goiás).
